rationale: I read the complete held EO 10704 (22 FR 2005, signed March 25, 1957, Change in the Membership of the President's Council on Youth Fitness): para. 1 sets the Council's membership (the Vice President as Chairman and five Secretaries) and para. 2 amends section 1 of EO 10673 accordingly. It has no own term. I read the held full text of EO 10931 (signed March 29, 1961): sec. 1 rewrites section 1 of EO 10673 with a new membership chaired by the Secretary of Health, Education, and Welfare, and sec. 2 provides 'The following-described orders, amending section 1 of Executive Order No. 10673, are hereby revoked: Executive Order No. 10704 of March 25, 1957. Executive Order No. 10740 of November 21, 1957. Executive Order No. 10785 of October 17, 1958.' That names EO 10704 by number and date and revokes the whole order, with no savings clause. The bare ACT:EO:10704>EO:10931 slice is the order heading; I rely on the sec. 2 wording read in the held file. D6 self-check: EO 10740 (November 21, 1957) and EO 10785 (October 17, 1958) further amend section 1 of EO 10673 'which was amended by Executive Order No. 10704', changing the membership again; they may have displaced EO 10704's membership text earlier, which would move the first end earlier but does not change the status. A search of the held full-run texts for '10704' finds EOs 10740, 10785, 10931 and unrelated numeric hits in EO 12354 and EO 9366; no held later instrument names or restores EO 10704. The OFR note 'Revoked by: EO 10931, March 29, 1961' and the 1989 snapshot row (revoked, actor EO 10931) agree. Both history observations were reviewed. Provisional NO hypothesis; the first effective end (1957-58 displacement or March 29, 1961 revocation) is not adjudicated.
